reasons: The cited termination-effects provision (p0019–p0022) indeed contains no transition assistance, no return/export of Customer Content or data, and no deletion certification, so the 'missing' status is correctly characterized for a hosted auction-platform service that stores Customer data.

The inserted subsections (v)–(vi) track the playbook preferred position closely: up to six months of transition assistance at Kubient's then-current rates, return of Customer Content/Requests/visitor data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and subsequent deletion with written certification.

The edit is directionally correct (pro-Customer), minimally invasive (appended as new clauses continuing the existing (i)–(iv) enumeration in the termination section), and consistent with the existing clause (iv) Confidential Information return/destroy obligation.
The comment accurately describes the change, cites the playbook position, and offers the 90-day fallback in the required tone and prefix.
Minor drafting nit (not disqualifying): the parenthetical 'up to six (6) (or, if requested, any shorter) months' is redundant with 'up to' and could be deleted for clarity.
